I can't verify the exact 2019 figure from here, so I can't give a sourced percentage. Surveys such as the World Values Survey and Pew's global attitudes work usually show large majorities of Italians rating free media as important, so my best estimate is roughly 70–80% saying it is "very important," but treat that as a guess. To get the real number, check the Pew Research Center 2019 global attitudes releases or the World Values Survey wave covering Italy.
